cases.title: Safe source freeze
cases.setup: Use a checkout with one committed file and one uncommitted sentinel.
cases.action: Create the v2 worktree and source lock. Compare the original bytes and Git status.
cases.expected: The original sentinel and status remain unchanged. All source pins and tool limits appear in the lock.

cases.title: Complete call inventory
cases.setup: Use the frozen baseline and all executable repository paths.
cases.action: Trace direct calls, wrappers, scripts, FFI, generated launch code, and inactive paths.
cases.expected: Every discovered runtime effect has a caller, owner, disposition, replacement task, and test reference.

cases.title: Product behavior coverage
cases.setup: Use the current CLI, account, role, project, Capsule, and workflow behavior register.
cases.action: Map every behavior to preservation, deliberate removal, or a visible blocker.
cases.expected: No retained behavior lacks an implementation task. Every removal names its specification basis.

cases.title: Real upstream contract map
cases.setup: Use the exact candidate SDK, protobufs, handlers, and drivers.
cases.action: Resolve each required operation to an actual symbol and field.
cases.expected: Proposed fields are marked proposed. Missing capabilities have upstream tasks. No moving source reference enters the lock.

cases.title: SDK mutual TLS
cases.setup: Use a disposable gateway with valid, invalid, and missing client certificates.
cases.action: Connect through the selected SDK and perform a scoped read.
cases.expected: The valid identity succeeds. Invalid and missing identities fail. No insecure TLS path is used.

cases.title: Concurrent explicit targets
cases.setup: Use two gateways with identical friendly sandbox names and different content sentinels.
cases.action: Interleave scoped read and allowed mutation requests without changing active registrations.
cases.expected: Each result matches its explicit target and workspace. No request reaches the other gateway.

cases.title: Strict v2 schemas
cases.setup: Prepare valid v2 configurations and variants with unknown fields, wrong versions, and ambiguous IDs.
cases.action: Parse and resolve each variant.
cases.expected: Valid inputs resolve once. Invalid inputs fail explicitly. No old schema or first-match fallback succeeds.

cases.title: Domain identity rules
cases.setup: Prepare two accounts, two policies, two trust classes, and one logical instance.
cases.action: Attempt domain reuse across each changed field.
cases.expected: Only identical admitted trust sets can reuse a domain. Human labels cannot replace stable identity.

cases.title: Operation state contract
cases.setup: Enumerate every frozen phase, outcome, error, and recovery transition.
cases.action: Apply legal and illegal transitions, including cancellation after an uncertain remote effect.
cases.expected: Legal transitions preserve receipts. Illegal transitions fail. Local cancellation does not imply remote termination.

cases.title: Honest test gate
cases.setup: Prepare one passing case, one failed assertion, one missing case, and one unavailable target.
cases.action: Run the harness and full-gate command.
cases.expected: Only the passing case reports PASS. The full gate fails for missing, failed, or blocked required cases.

cases.title: Disposable resource ownership
cases.setup: Create owned test resources and unrelated sentinel resources in the same environment.
cases.action: Interrupt setup and run scoped cleanup.
cases.expected: Cleanup changes only recorded owned resources. Uncertain cleanup remains visible. Sentinels survive.

cases.title: Evidence secret protection
cases.setup: Use synthetic credential canaries in allowed secret inputs and denied ordinary records.
cases.action: Exercise log, report, panic, transcript, and evidence serialization paths.
cases.expected: No known canary appears in ordinary artifacts. A leakage assertion fails the harness.

cases.title: Production dependency boundary
cases.setup: Use Cargo metadata for the final candidate graph.
cases.action: Inspect dependency edges and compile forbidden-import fixtures.
cases.expected: Core has no runtime or database types. Capsule has no host credential path. Forbidden fixtures fail.

cases.title: No production backend selection
cases.setup: Use the active crate graph and application composition.
cases.action: Search and inspect runtime enums, trait implementations, feature flags, and command dispatch.
cases.expected: OpenShell is the only production sandbox adapter. Mocks exist only in test scope.

cases.title: Authoritative activation observations
cases.setup: Create a sandbox and prepare forged helper claims plus real gateway observations.
cases.action: Attempt activation with missing, stale, and mismatched image, policy, provider, or generation evidence.
cases.expected: Only matching authoritative observations can satisfy the barrier. A helper echo cannot replace them.

cases.title: Effective policy source
cases.setup: Use a sandbox policy and a different gateway global policy.
cases.action: Load the global policy and query actual accepted revisions.
cases.expected: Jackin displays the effective replacement source. It does not report an imaginary policy intersection.

cases.title: Provider authority observation
cases.setup: Use a provider binding that adds approved endpoint access.
cases.action: Attach, revoke, and change the binding while querying installed status.
cases.expected: Activation uses the installed revision. Added access is visible. Revocation cannot remain falsely ready.

cases.title: Same-name replacement fencing
cases.setup: Record sandbox A identity and generation. Replace it with B under the same name.
cases.action: Deliver delayed stop, start, delete, exec, policy, provider, transfer, and service mutations for A.
cases.expected: Every mutation rejects the stale binding. B and its data remain unchanged.

cases.title: Mutation replay integrity
cases.setup: Use one effect with a persisted request ID and canonical digest.
cases.action: Lose the first response. Retry the same request. Then change the payload under that ID.
cases.expected: The identical retry causes no duplicate effect. The changed payload fails. The original result stays attributable.

cases.title: Scope and permission masking
cases.setup: Use two workspaces and a caller without authority in one scope.
cases.action: Read, mutate, and replay requests across the forbidden scope.
cases.expected: Access fails without foreign data exposure. Permission masking does not cause local data deletion.

cases.title: Lost effectful exec response
cases.setup: Start a counted effect through the qualified exec API and drop its response.
cases.action: Recover the operation and attempt its permitted replay path.
cases.expected: The effect count stays one, or the result remains OutcomeUnknown. No new-ID blind retry occurs.

cases.title: Strict worker immutability
cases.setup: Use a worker with immutable candidate, checks, and root plus approved scratch.
cases.action: Attempt write, chmod, chown, rename, unlink, hardlink, xattr, and symlink-based escape operations.
cases.expected: Every out-of-grant content or metadata mutation fails. Approved scratch remains usable.

cases.title: Worker resource limits
cases.setup: Use fixed memory, CPU, PID, disk, output, and deadline limits.
cases.action: Exhaust each resource with disposable fixtures. Spawn child and grandchild processes.
cases.expected: Limits apply to the required scope. Output stays bounded. Timeout cleanup removes all owned worker processes.

cases.title: Worker authority denial
cases.setup: Use a strict worker with no account, provider, host mount, or ordinary network grant.
cases.action: Probe credential canaries, host sockets, DNS, IPv4, IPv6, and metadata endpoints.
cases.expected: All forbidden access fails. No unapproved account or network path appears.

cases.title: Trustworthy worker completion
cases.setup: Use success, nonzero exit, signal, OOM, timeout, and lost-status fixtures.
cases.action: Observe each result through the runtime completion contract.
cases.expected: Results remain distinct. Unknown infrastructure state cannot become a passing verdict.

cases.title: Ordinary native rebuilds
cases.setup: Use an approved native Rust network test and a fixed executable path.
cases.action: Run Cargo and nextest. Edit and rebuild twice at the same path. Repeat the allowed connection.
cases.expected: All approved development cycles work under the selected contract without path changes or Docker execution substitutes.

cases.title: Replaced executable authority
cases.setup: Use a protected provider route and an untrusted replacement executable.
cases.action: Replace or race the executable while it requests the protected route.
cases.expected: Replacement cannot acquire unrelated credential authority. Destination and provider restrictions remain enforced.

cases.title: Default-off engine
cases.setup: Use a role and target with engine access disabled.
cases.action: Load, prewarm, inspect, stop, and delete the domain.
cases.expected: No engine VM, endpoint, credential, engine prewarm, or engine-owned storage appears.

cases.title: Companion ownership identity
cases.setup: Use two domains and a restarted parent generation.
cases.action: Request each endpoint from the other domain and from an old generation.
cases.expected: Only the current owning domain can use its endpoint. Names alone cannot transfer ownership.

cases.title: Companion lifecycle
cases.setup: Use an admitted domain with engine data and running Docker children.
cases.action: Stop, start, recreate, and delete the parent.
cases.expected: Stop revokes access. Start issues new access. Recreation uses a new engine. Delete confirms destruction and revocation.

cases.title: Companion failure cleanup
cases.setup: Use checkpoints at every companion provisioning and cleanup transition.
cases.action: Kill the parent, gateway, or provisioning process at each checkpoint. Recover the owner.
cases.expected: Recovery does not duplicate engines. Orphans are reconciled. Uncertain cleanup never reports completed deletion.

cases.title: Confined project projection
cases.setup: Place approved project files beside forbidden host and account sentinels.
cases.action: Access the projection from the daemon machine and privileged Docker children.
cases.expected: Only approved project data is reachable. Account and control-state sentinels remain outside daemon authority.

cases.title: Live Docker bind behavior
cases.setup: Use Compose binds at the agreed absolute project path.
cases.action: Edit, rename, create, and delete files from both sides. Observe file watches.
cases.expected: Both sides see the specified changes and ownership. A streamed build context is not accepted as a bind substitute.

cases.title: Projection path attacks
cases.setup: Add escaping links, traversal paths, and unsupported special-file fixtures.
cases.action: Attempt projection and child-container access through each fixture.
cases.expected: The projection rejects or confines each case. It never widens the host source mount.

cases.title: Complete Docker API behavior
cases.setup: Use the authenticated managed engine endpoint.
cases.action: Run online pull, build, run, exec, logs, events, and concurrent long-lived streams.
cases.expected: Required API behavior works without a host socket. Stream cancellation does not corrupt ownership.

cases.title: Outer engine egress
cases.setup: Define one allowed destination and denied destinations for the companion.
cases.action: Connect from the daemon, a build step, and a child container.
cases.expected: All three layers obey outer egress. Agent binary policy alone does not satisfy this assertion.

cases.title: Dynamic ports and callbacks
cases.setup: Use concurrent Testcontainers services with dynamic published ports.
cases.action: Discover service hosts. Test callbacks, collisions, exhaustion, release, and reuse.
cases.expected: Each route reaches its owner. Failures are bounded. Revoked routes cannot be reused through stale credentials.

cases.title: Aggregate engine budgets
cases.setup: Set one domain budget for the engine and all children.
cases.action: Start multiple containers that jointly exceed CPU, RAM, PID, disk, and network limits.
cases.expected: The aggregate admitted budget remains enforced. Per-child limits alone do not pass.

cases.title: Real Compose and Testcontainers
cases.setup: Use two managed companions, a live project, and an ordinary native test project.
cases.action: Run Compose and Testcontainers after two source edits. Repeat from fresh resources independently.
cases.expected: Real service data exchange succeeds. Ownership, isolation, cleanup, and native rebuild assertions also pass.

cases.title: Journal crash boundaries
cases.setup: Use fault points before and after each local commit and simulated external effect.
cases.action: Crash and restart the state coordinator at every point.
cases.expected: Request identities and receipts survive. Recovery follows the declared state table without duplicate effects.

cases.title: Unknown outcome recovery
cases.setup: Lose responses from create, exec, stop, delete, and publication effects.
cases.action: Restart host control and inspect each operation.
cases.expected: Each operation resolves through qualified replay or stays explicitly uncertain. No guessed success appears.

cases.title: Fresh v2 state
cases.setup: Provide a clean directory, a valid v2 database, and an old-format database.
cases.action: Initialize and open each state location.
cases.expected: Fresh and valid v2 state work. Old state is rejected with fresh-setup guidance and remains unchanged.

cases.title: Local IPC authentication
cases.setup: Use the host service, another local user, and unsafe socket-path fixtures.
cases.action: Attempt connection through valid and forged peer identities or symlink paths.
cases.expected: Only the authorized local peer succeeds. Socket replacement cannot grant host authority.

cases.title: Host service death
cases.setup: Run a remote Capsule with a live PTY and a durable operation record.
cases.action: Kill the local host service. Restart it and reconnect.
cases.expected: Remote execution continues. Recovery preserves the binding and does not replay uncertain agent startup.

cases.title: Approval-service outage
cases.setup: Run a domain that requests a host-approved action. Stop the host control service.
cases.action: Attempt the action and then restore host control.
cases.expected: The action stays unavailable or pending. The remote coding session does not die or gain default approval.

cases.title: Authentication expiry
cases.setup: Use qualified mTLS and intended token-based routes with invalid and expired credentials.
cases.action: Rotate or expire credentials during reads and an operation boundary.
cases.expected: Errors and supported refresh follow the upstream contract. Scope and server verification remain intact.

cases.title: Connection secret redaction
cases.setup: Construct transport errors and Debug output with synthetic certificates, keys, and tokens.
cases.action: Serialize diagnostics and error reports.
cases.expected: Secret bytes stay absent from ordinary output. Target attribution remains useful.

cases.title: Partial inventory and false absence
cases.setup: Use paginated resources and inject permission, authentication, and transport failures.
cases.action: List, refresh, and run cleanup preflight.
cases.expected: Partial results remain partial. No retained row or checkpoint is purged from ambiguous absence.

cases.title: Complete role cache identity
cases.setup: Vary each declared build input independently.
cases.action: Resolve the role and compare cache keys.
cases.expected: Every meaningful input changes the identity. Unchanged valid inputs can reuse the exact artifact.

cases.title: Complete installed agent set
cases.setup: Declare two agents but provide a candidate image that lacks one.
cases.action: Resolve selection and validate the advertised executable inventory.
cases.expected: Validation fails for the missing agent. The image cannot be reused under a different selected-agent assumption.

cases.title: Ignore rules and secret-dependent builds
cases.setup: Use ignored files, included files, and an explicitly secret-dependent build fixture.
cases.action: Change each input and compare build identity and logs.
cases.expected: Ignore behavior matches the actual build context. Secret bytes do not leak. Secret-output caching follows its declared policy.

cases.title: Explicit builder routing
cases.setup: Configure builder A and an ambient DOCKER_HOST for builder B.
cases.action: Build a sentinel role and inspect authorized build records.
cases.expected: Only builder A receives source and approved secrets. Unexpected ambient routing cannot override it.

cases.title: Remote immutable image delivery
cases.setup: Use a local image ID and a reachable registry artifact with an immutable digest.
cases.action: Deliver to a remote target reference and resolve pull authorization.
cases.expected: The remote plan uses the registry digest. A local image ID is never treated as a pullable reference.

cases.title: Platform artifact identity
cases.setup: Use a multi-platform OCI index and mismatched architecture fixtures.
cases.action: Select the target platform and record both index and platform manifest.
cases.expected: The exact platform artifact is explicit. An unsupported architecture fails before activation.

cases.title: Separate builder outage
cases.setup: Run a healthy remote gateway and then stop only its independent builder.
cases.action: Inspect, attach, stop, and attempt a new uncached build.
cases.expected: Management still works. Only builder-dependent work fails. Shared physical-engine loss is not misreported.

cases.title: Unprivileged role ABI
cases.setup: Build the complete role with the C08 layout.
cases.action: Start it on the qualified target and attempt normal setup.
cases.expected: Setup needs no root, sudo, chown, setuid, firewall, or namespace operation.

cases.title: Advertised agent validation
cases.setup: Use the built role and its complete executable inventory.
cases.action: Check each executable through OpenShell and run its declared startup route.
cases.expected: Every advertised binary exists at its recorded version. Runtime identity matches the qualified image evidence.

cases.title: Empty canonical Capsule startup
cases.setup: Create a domain with canonical restart policy Never.
cases.action: Inspect Capsule before activation and after a new boot.
cases.expected: Each fresh boot has zero agent sessions. Setup cannot start a default agent implicitly.

cases.title: Frame allocation limits
cases.setup: Feed maximum, excessive, truncated, and nested protocol frames.
cases.action: Decode both protocol directions under bounded memory assertions.
cases.expected: Valid limits work. Invalid frames fail before unbounded allocation or arithmetic overflow.

cases.title: Protocol compatibility
cases.setup: Use golden v2 frames and incompatible major-version peers.
cases.action: Negotiate capabilities and request an effect.
cases.expected: Compatible frames retain meaning. Incompatible major versions fail before the effect.

cases.title: Protocol fuzzing
cases.setup: Use bounded random frames and valid messages with mutated identifiers.
cases.action: Fuzz encode/decode, state transitions, and diagnostics separation.
cases.expected: No panic, unsafe allocation, cross-session input, or diagnostic-as-command behavior occurs.

cases.title: Nonroot Capsule process
cases.setup: Run the Capsule test fixture as an ordinary user with no agent credentials.
cases.action: Start serve, inspect its boot, and request deterministic fixture sessions.
cases.expected: No root or PID1 assumption appears. Production agent execution is not part of this host unit fixture.

cases.title: Session child lifetime
cases.setup: Use deterministic PTY fixture children and grandchildren.
cases.action: Exit one child, detach one client, resize, interrupt, and stop another session.
cases.expected: Capsule and unrelated sessions survive. Normal child groups are reaped. No security-boundary claim follows from process groups.

cases.title: Bounded replay and snapshots
cases.setup: Produce output beyond retention with one stalled viewer.
cases.action: Drain the PTY and request replay plus a snapshot watermark.
cases.expected: Memory stays bounded. The stalled viewer receives a gap. Snapshot and later output have a consistent sequence boundary.

cases.title: Binary relay transport
cases.setup: Use a real OpenShell exec stream without an outer PTY.
cases.action: Send all byte values, large frames, diagnostics, resize, and terminal input.
cases.expected: Protocol bytes are unchanged. Diagnostics stay on stderr. Inner PTY behavior remains correct.

cases.title: Same-PTY reconnect
cases.setup: Record a live inner process identity and output sequence.
cases.action: Detach, break the network, create a fresh relay, and reconnect.
cases.expected: The same surviving PTY continues. Reconnect uses a new exec request ID and application replay, not admission replay.

cases.title: Single input writer
cases.setup: Attach two viewers and one writer to a session.
cases.action: Transfer the writer lease. Send stale-generation and unacknowledged input during disconnect.
cases.expected: Only the current writer input succeeds. Stale input is discarded. Lost keystrokes are not replayed automatically.

cases.title: Portable worktree and unpushed commits
cases.setup: Use a linked worktree with unpushed commits and dirty selected files.
cases.action: Export and materialize it on an independent remote filesystem.
cases.expected: The checkout and Git base are valid without host .git pointers. Selected unpushed and dirty content survives.

cases.title: Atomic materialization
cases.setup: Import a multi-file source into a unique staging epoch.
cases.action: Interrupt transfer, corrupt one chunk, and retry through the allowed operation contract.
cases.expected: Partial or corrupt staging never becomes active. Only a verified complete epoch is published.

cases.title: Archive and path safety
cases.setup: Prepare traversal, escaping-link, special-file, excessive-size, and credential-store fixtures.
cases.action: Validate and extract them into a disposable staging directory.
cases.expected: Unsafe inputs fail without outside writes. Known credential stores are excluded. Budget violations remain explicit.

cases.title: Source mode and host Git safety
cases.setup: Use Shared, Worktree, and Clone fixtures with malicious repository command configuration.
cases.action: Materialize through live and snapshot profiles and inspect host effects.
cases.expected: Requested live behavior stays live. Snapshot behavior is explicit. Repository settings cannot execute unapproved host commands.

cases.title: Stable account selection
cases.setup: Save an instance with account A and later change the user's default to B.
cases.action: Reconnect and create an approved session from the saved instance.
cases.expected: Account A remains selected. A revision change requires re-admission instead of silent reassignment.

cases.title: Private authority scope
cases.setup: Use a private account, personal workspace, and team workspace with another member.
cases.action: Attempt private-account admission to both scopes.
cases.expected: Only a scope authorized for that account passes. Separate sandboxes alone do not imply account privacy.

cases.title: Account-provider activation binding
cases.setup: Use a saved grant and change its provider or policy revision before activation.
cases.action: Attempt StartSession with the stale activation inputs.
cases.expected: Activation fails until the current authorized binding and effective policy are observed and admitted.

cases.title: Native credential isolation
cases.setup: Use two approved native-login accounts and one generic shell domain.
cases.action: Inspect permitted account files and attempt cross-domain access.
cases.expected: Each domain receives only its admitted files. The generic shell cannot read either account store.

cases.title: Atomic rotating refresh state
cases.setup: Use a native-login route with rotating tokens and explicit single-writer scope.
cases.action: Interrupt publication and attempt concurrent refresh from another writer or device.
cases.expected: One valid revision survives. Unsupported cross-device sharing fails explicitly. No generic refresh broker appears.

cases.title: Real advertised agent routes
cases.setup: Use approved disposable credentials for every advertised authentication route.
cases.action: Perform an actual authenticated coding task through each agent adapter.
cases.expected: Each advertised route completes its declared task. Version output or mocked login cannot substitute.

cases.title: Activation barrier negatives
cases.setup: Prepare mismatched image, generation, account grant, materialization epoch, and missing policy observations.
cases.action: Attempt launch activation for each mismatch.
cases.expected: Every mismatch blocks StartSession. SandboxReady and helper receipts alone are insufficient.

cases.title: Launch interruption and replay
cases.setup: Inject loss after build, create, publication, activation receipt, and StartSession.
cases.action: Restart host control and recover the original operation.
cases.expected: Work resumes only through qualified recovery. No duplicate agent or silent replacement appears.

cases.title: Complete native vertical path
cases.setup: Use one actual role, project, target, account, and fresh configuration.
cases.action: Load, produce useful agent output, detach, reconnect, inspect, and stop.
cases.expected: Every phase has matching receipts. Reconnect preserves a surviving PTY. No direct Docker agent execution occurs.

cases.title: Domain split and collaboration
cases.setup: Use two accounts with separate materializations and a proposed shared-write option.
cases.action: Create sessions and then request shared writable source.
cases.expected: Accounts remain separate domains. Shared writes require explicit collaboration authorization and visible risk.

cases.title: Default and in-domain shells
cases.setup: Use an account domain and its logical instance.
cases.action: Open the default shell, then an explicitly selected in-domain shell.
cases.expected: The default shell is credential-free and separate. The in-domain shell has a trusted inherited-authority label.

cases.title: Session and instance lifecycle
cases.setup: Use several sessions across two domains.
cases.action: Interrupt one, detach another, exit one agent, and restart Capsule explicitly.
cases.expected: Unrelated sessions survive appropriate actions. A new Capsule boot cannot claim the old PTY still exists.

cases.title: Usage cache identity
cases.setup: Use two accounts, two credential revisions, and stale or failed provider responses.
cases.action: Resolve and display usage snapshots.
cases.expected: Entries remain isolated by stable identity and revision. Stale or unavailable usage does not become zero.

cases.title: Ended-run usage denial
cases.setup: End an account grant while a delayed usage request remains queued.
cases.action: Deliver that request and attempt unrelated account enumeration.
cases.expected: Both unauthorized requests fail. No global account catalog reaches Capsule.

cases.title: Host affordance injection
cases.setup: Emit hostile terminal escape sequences and unsolicited helper clipboard, URL, and export requests.
cases.action: Observe the desktop without a matching operator action.
cases.expected: No host action occurs. Untrusted output cannot forge trusted labels or approval state.

cases.title: Bound approval semantics
cases.setup: Approve one fixed tool request, then vary domain, image, argv, inputs, destination, expiry, or replay identity.
cases.action: Execute each changed request and replay the original effect.
cases.expected: Every changed or replayed unauthorized request fails. Only the exact admitted operation can run.

cases.title: Isolated secret consumer
cases.setup: Use a coding domain and a separately approved tool domain with a synthetic secret.
cases.action: Run the fixed consumer and inspect the coding PTY, logs, and host command path.
cases.expected: Only the approved consumer receives the secret. No arbitrary host shell or coding-session injection occurs.

cases.title: Independent checkpoint restore
cases.setup: Create an accepted checkpoint outside source-owned storage.
cases.action: Delete the source sandbox and owned storage. Restore into a new admitted domain.
cases.expected: Required project and approved conversation state survive. The checkpoint does not depend on the deleted resource.

cases.title: Dirty untracked and unpushed retention
cases.setup: Use tracked changes, selected untracked files, deletions, and unpushed commits.
cases.action: Checkpoint and restore the project.
cases.expected: All selected changes and the Git base match the manifest. No category silently disappears.

cases.title: Checkpoint credential exclusion
cases.setup: Place known account and token canaries beside allowlisted conversation data.
cases.action: Create the checkpoint and inspect its manifest and content.
cases.expected: Known credentials and unrequested host data are absent. The report does not claim a scan proves arbitrary secrecy.

cases.title: Conflict-aware export
cases.setup: Launch from baseline A and change the host checkout to B before return.
cases.action: Apply a returned patch based on A.
cases.expected: Conflicting content is preserved and reported. Host work is not overwritten blindly.

cases.title: Failed handoff safety
cases.setup: Use an accepted checkpoint and independently authorized destination.
cases.action: Fail transfer, admission, resume, and source retirement at separate points.
cases.expected: The last accepted checkpoint remains recoverable. The source retires only after destination acceptance.

cases.title: Scoped eject and exile
cases.setup: Use instances across two projects and two targets.
cases.action: Eject one instance and bulk-exile one explicit scope.
cases.expected: Only selected domains stop. Retained state follows its documented contract. Other scopes remain unchanged.

cases.title: Purge ownership guards
cases.setup: Use original checkouts, owned runtime data, external PVCs, shared providers, and masked absence.
cases.action: Request purge under valid and uncertain ownership conditions.
cases.expected: Only confirmed selected owned data can be removed. Original and unrelated resources survive.

cases.title: CLI and JSON contract
cases.setup: Use all frozen command forms, ambiguous selectors, and old backend flags.
cases.action: Parse commands and compare JSON output with v2 golden schemas.
cases.expected: Valid commands preserve semantics. Ambiguous and obsolete forms fail clearly. No v1 output compatibility path appears.

cases.title: Partial fleet visibility
cases.setup: Use three targets, paginated scopes, and one unreachable target.
cases.action: Refresh the Console while one target fails mid-list.
cases.expected: Reachable targets stay usable. Stale rows remain. Coverage and completeness are explicit.

cases.title: Trusted status presentation
cases.setup: Make an agent print false account labels, done events, and a fabricated passing result.
cases.action: Inspect Console state and attempt cleanup or acceptance.
cases.expected: Trusted host labels remain distinct. Agent output cannot grant authority, delete data, or set a verification verdict.

cases.title: Private developer forward
cases.setup: Run a private sandbox service and an authorized local client.
cases.action: Create a loopback-bound authenticated forward and attempt external access.
cases.expected: The intended client works. Unapproved public access fails. Forward ownership and cleanup stay scoped.

cases.title: Public exposure separation
cases.setup: Request a public service and a Capsule control endpoint.
cases.action: Inspect grants, listener TLS, application authentication, and exposure refusal.
cases.expected: Public exposure needs its own grant and authentication contract. Capsule control is never public.

cases.title: Artifact liveness under outage
cases.setup: Reference an image from an active domain and a retained checkpoint on an unavailable target.
cases.action: Run cache and image-prune planning.
cases.expected: Required or uncertain artifacts remain live. Only confirmed owned unused artifacts are eligible.

cases.title: Safe prewarm
cases.setup: Use a role with an optional account and optional engine capability.
cases.action: Prewarm tools and images without launch.
cases.expected: No account grant, credential exposure, companion, or engine prewarm occurs.

cases.title: Diagnostics and resource attribution
cases.setup: Vary builder, gateway, host, and companion availability independently.
cases.action: Run doctor and inspect resource summaries.
cases.expected: Failures identify the correct owner. Requested, enforced, reserved, and measured resources stay distinct.

cases.title: Frozen verification binding
cases.setup: Change the candidate, image, check bundle, argv, or budget after a prior passing check.
cases.action: Attempt to reuse the prior evidence for acceptance.
cases.expected: The host rejects stale evidence. Every verdict matches the complete frozen input identity.

cases.title: Verification outcome classes
cases.setup: Run successful, failing, timed-out, cancelled, killed, and disconnected checks.
cases.action: Record verdict and cleanup results.
cases.expected: Each class remains distinct. Unknown completion and failed cleanup never count as a passing check.

cases.title: No verification fallback
cases.setup: Make the OpenShell verifier unavailable while host Python and Docker remain available.
cases.action: Request independent verification.
cases.expected: The request is blocked. No host or direct Docker verification process starts.

cases.title: Engine capability change
cases.setup: Use a running engine-disabled domain with retained work.
cases.action: Request engine enablement on supported and unsupported targets.
cases.expected: The supported route checkpoints and reprovisions. Unsupported targets reject before launch. No hidden sidecar appears.

cases.title: Full retained product coverage
cases.setup: Use the P01 behavior register and the integrated v2 application.
cases.action: Execute each retained user journey and inspect its replacement path.
cases.expected: Every retained journey has real evidence or a release blocker. No old runtime helper serves a feature.

cases.title: External metadata outage
cases.setup: Run a useful local session and make pull-request or CI metadata unavailable.
cases.action: Refresh status and perform local project work.
cases.expected: Local state remains useful. External data is marked unavailable without ending the session.

cases.title: Local container target matrix
cases.setup: Prepare native Linux, macOS Docker Desktop, and macOS OrbStack rows.
cases.action: Run the required container journeys separately on each tuple.
cases.expected: Every claimed row has its own evidence. Live source behavior, identity, and cleanup match that row's contract.

cases.title: Remote container target matrix
cases.setup: Prepare independent remote Linux and required remote macOS gateways.
cases.action: Build locally, deliver by registry, materialize remotely, attach, checkpoint, and clean up.
cases.expected: No laptop path or local image-ID assumption leaks into remote execution. Authorization and retention remain correct.

cases.title: VM identity and resource shapes
